purpose: Automate the already observed primary-source comparison for six historical COMPASS proton pion views without certifying unresolved kinematics or uncertainty semantics.

primary_source.snapshot_limit: The archive was served with Last-Modified 8 May 2024. Its filename does not establish the exact original KPSY author inputs.

selection.cut: Keep the existing strict reported-mean pT<0.8 GeV cut for pT projections only; compare all raw rows including excluded rows.

identity: Require the complete primary section labels, pion charges, full-range selection and ordered numeric/units header. Select Collins by its label, never by resemblance of values. Read the archive as bounded text; never execute or extract archive members to the filesystem.

exact_comparison.policy: Exact Decimal equality before normalization, with unique coordinate matching and complete coverage. No sign, scale, error, cut, data value or kinematic replacement. No rounding tolerance or acceptance-threshold adjustment.

means.policy: Preserve all six literal primary means and their exact/unequal comparisons with the legacy decimals. Unequal means remain unverified; do not round, substitute, certify extra digits, impose a display-interval acceptance gate or count them as exact crosschecks.

bins: Record literal left-closed/right-open primary projection bounds separately from legacy means. Encode the source's inf. upper endpoint as null with upper_unbounded=true and its literal preserved, never as an inferred finite endpoint or JSON Infinity. This is source metadata, not a prediction integration prescription.
uncertainty: Sigma exactly matches legacy error_u but its statistical/total composition is not established. Keep statistical_error=null, reported_error_u unchanged, systematic components empty with explicit unresolved status. Do not manufacture zero systematics, per-point 0.6*stat errors, covariance or a normalization nuisance.
source_version_limit: Preprint 3% and final-journal 5% scale statements remain distinct. This crosscheck selects neither as a likelihood prescription and does not recover the original fit.

controls: rehashed source-derived candidate metadata and report-count tampering
validation_policy.regression: All existing normalized scientific scalars, errors, reported means, source rows and historical selections must be unchanged. New source metadata and narrower primary-crosscheck blockers are the only candidate differences.
required_checks: Linux Snakemake closure and historical-intake/cache verification
validation_policy.evidence_scope: Small fixtures are explicitly synthetic; the separately acquired primary archive is real source evidence. Neither authorizes a real-data fit or changes a failed scientific gate.

limitations: Partial primary numerical agreement, not complete mean-kinematic validation
Unresolved Sigma composition, systematic and normalization covariance, projection overlap and acceptance
No phase/depolarization transformation, nuclear prescription, likelihood, fit or experimental admission
Original author fitting code/modified HOPPET and unrounded inputs remain unlocated
Existing KPSY partial-moment center failures and production prerequisites remain unchanged
